proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ s₁ s₂ A B hc hAB hA1 hB1 hA2 hB2
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have h1 : inner ℝ (s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center) (B -ᵥ A) = 0 := EuclideanGeometry.inner_vsub_vsub_of_mem_sphere_of_mem_sphere hA1 hB1 hA2 hB2
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  have h2 : inner ℝ (midpoint ℝ A B -ᵥ s₁.center) (B -ᵥ A) = 0 := by
    have := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.inner_vsub_center_midpoint_vsub hA1 hB1
    rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, inner_neg_left, neg_eq_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hne : B -ᵥ A ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr hAB.symm
  let o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2) := Module.Oriented.positiveOrientation
  have r1 := (o.inner_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_smul_rotation_pi_div_two (x := B -ᵥ A) (y := s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center)).mp (by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact h1)
  have r2 := (o.inner_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_smul_rotation_pi_div_two (x := B -ᵥ A) (y := midpoint ℝ A B -ᵥ s₁.center)).mp (by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact h2)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := r1.resolve_left hne
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := r2.resolve_left hne
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_smul] at ha
    exact hc (vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq.mp ha.symm).symm
  have : midpoint ℝ A B = AffineMap.lineMap s₁.center s₂.center (b / a) := by
    have e3 : (b / a) * a = b := by field_simp
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, eq_vadd_iff_vsub_eq, ← hb, ← ha, smul_smul, e3]
  rw [this]
  exact AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair _ _ _
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (s₁ s₂ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B : P), s₁.center ≠ s₂.center → A ≠ B → A ∈ s₁ → B ∈ s₁ → A ∈ s₂ → B ∈ s₂ → inner ℝ (s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center) (B -ᵥ A) = 0 ∧ midpoint ℝ A B ∈ line[ℝ, s₁.center, s₂.center]
